name: TVAM Integrator
definition: A base class for volumetric additive manufacturing (TVAM) integrators that handles projector ray sampling, time sampling, and regular vs. stochastic sampling modes.
summary: The TVAM Integrator is a base class for volumetric additive manufacturing that handles projector ray, time, and sampling modes, diverging from standard ray casting by focusing on temporal and geometric projector emission sampling.
